confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on two web searches: Numbeo-derived figures via Expatica (June 2026) and MyLifeElsewhere. They cover meals, cappuccino and beer. I found no reliable current Dresden prices for cocktails or restaurant wine, so I estimated those from the local beer price (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.05x beer). I converted euros to USD at roughly 1.15. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings, and are the least certain. The FX figure is the RBA's 4 pm rate for 18 Nov 2026, the latest confirmed rate in my search. A 19 Nov value appeared but looked possibly provisional or stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Dresden is a mid-sized eastern German city that is somewhat cheaper than Munich or Berlin for restaurants. Beer, coffee and meal prices come from Dresden-specific aggregates. Cocktail, wine and accommodation are scaled from typical German tourist-city levels.
